entry.title: New: Resolution 358 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO NA MAMO O KĀWĀ

Approves a grant of $123,788 to Na Mamo O Kāwā, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to continue providing land stewardship and cultural education for properties in Kāwā, Hīlea Nui, and Kaʻalaiki, (Tax Map Keys: 9-5-016:006, 025 and 9-5-017:005, 007), pursuant to Section 10-16(h) of the Hawaiʻi County Charter.
